title: Advanced fluorine chemistry in >4.2 V high-voltage lithium metal batteries
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6CS00326E, Review Article
Yu Sun, Junjie Du, Daxian Zuo, Tao Yu, Shaohua Guo, Haoshen Zhou
This review systematically summarizes fluorine chemistry in high-voltage lithium metal batteries, highlighting its key roles and prospects to provide a comprehensive guideline for engineering safe, durable, and high-energy-density batteries.
